description: This file implements a POSIX-specific file enumerator class for traversing directories and files, including functions for retrieving file info, pattern matching, and directory traversal logic.

classes.name: FileEnumerator
classes.description: A class for enumerating files and directories in a specified path, supporting recursion, pattern matching, and filtering by file type.

classes.name: FileEnumerator::FileInfo
classes.description: A structure holding information about a file, including its name, size, last modified time, and directory status.

methods.name: GetStat
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a file, following or not following symlinks based on show_links.

methods.name: FileEnumerator::Next
methods.description: Returns the next file path in the enumeration, handling directory traversal and pattern matching.

methods.name: FileEnumerator::GetInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the current file in the enumeration.

methods.name: FileEnumerator::IsPatternMatched
methods.description: Checks if a given file path matches the specified pattern.
